answers.text: Atomicity is the number of atoms in a molecule. Oxygen O2 is diatomic because its molecule contains two oxygen atoms.
A molecule is the smallest unit of a substance that can exist independently and retains its chemical properties.
An ion is an atom or group of atoms with a net electric charge. A simple ion has one atom, such as Na+. A polyatomic ion has multiple atoms, such as sulfate SO4 2-.
Monoatomic particles contain one atom, such as He. Diatomic molecules have two atoms, such as O2. Polyatomic molecules have more than two atoms, such as O3 and S8.
